items.zh: 上市滿兩年的股票才選
items.en: Only stocks listed for at least two years

items.zh: 只看上櫃，而且排除上市不到 60 個交易日的新股
items.en: OTC (TPEx) stocks only, excluding new listings under 60 trading days

items.zh: 過去 20 天每天都有成交、20 日均量超過 500 張的才選
items.en: Traded every day for the past 20 days, with 20-day average volume above 500 lots

items.zh: 只選中型股：市值排在全市場第 30～70 百分位之間
items.en: Mid caps only: market cap between the 30th and 70th percentile of the market

items.zh: 資本額介於 10 億到 50 億元之間
items.en: Paid-in capital between 1 and 5 billion TWD

items.zh: 20 日平均週轉率在 1%～5% 之間
items.en: 20-day average turnover rate between 1% and 5%

items.zh: 排除金融與營建，只要普通股
items.en: Exclude financials and construction, common stocks only

items.zh: 只在我給的 10 檔自選股裡面挑
items.en: Pick only from my own list of 10 stocks

items.zh: 跟台積電、聯發科、日月光三檔過去一年日報酬相關性平均超過 0.5 的股票才選
items.en: Only stocks whose daily returns over the past year correlate above 0.5 on average with TSMC, MediaTek and ASE

args.universe: ADD(ADD(CORR(250, RET(1, close), BASKET_MEAN(symbol == "2330", RET(1, close))), CORR(250, RET(1, close), BASKET_MEAN(symbol == "2454", RET(1, close)))), CORR(250, RET(1, close), BASKET_MEAN(symbol == "3711", RET(1, close)))) > 1.5

items.zh: 跟我給的三檔種子股，月營收年增序列相關性高的才選
items.en: Only stocks whose monthly revenue growth correlates highly with my three seed stocks

items.zh: 近一年最大跌幅小於 40% 的才選
items.en: Only stocks whose largest drop over the past year is under 40%

items.zh: 收盤剛站上 250 日均線（20 天內才站上）的才選
items.en: Only stocks that just closed above the 250-day average (within the last 20 days)

args.universe: close > ROLL_MEAN(250, close) && COUNT(20, close > ROLL_MEAN(250, close)) < 20

items.zh: 融資使用率低於 30%、券資比高於 10% 的才選
items.en: Margin utilization under 30% and short-to-margin ratio above 10%

items.zh: 排除過去 60 天出現過漲停或跌停（單日 ±9.5%）的股票
items.en: Exclude stocks that closed at limit up or limit down in the past 60 days

items.zh: 排除全額交割股、處置股、注意股
items.en: Exclude full-delivery, disposition and attention stocks

items.zh: 只選市值前 30%，但不要台積電、鴻海
items.en: Top 30% by market cap, but without TSMC and Hon Hai

items.zh: 最近 5 天沒有發布重大訊息的股票才選
items.en: Only stocks with no material announcement in the past 5 days

items.zh: 只選外資已經連買 3 天以上的股票
items.en: Only stocks with foreign investors net buying for 3 or more days in a row

items.zh: 月營收創一年新高之後 20 個交易日內的才選
items.en: Only stocks within 20 trading days after monthly revenue hits a one-year high

items.zh: 股價（當天看盤價）介於 50 元到 300 元之間的才選
items.en: Only stocks priced (as quoted that day) between 50 and 300

items.zh: 收盤剛站上 20 日均線那天（黃金交叉）的才選
items.en: Only on the day the close crosses above the 20-day moving average (golden cross)

items.zh: 收盤高於 20 日成交均價的才選
items.en: Only stocks closing above the 20-day volume-weighted average price

items.zh: 資本額相近的互比：市值切 10 組，組內比 20 日漲幅
items.en: Compare stocks of similar size: split by market cap into 10 groups, rank 20-day return within each group

formulas: SUB(RET(20, close), RATIO(GSUM(CS_QCUT(10, fund.mktcap), RET(20, close)), GSUM(CS_QCUT(10, fund.mktcap), MASK(VALID(RET(20, close)), 1:RATIO))))

items.zh: 表現相近的互比：用日報酬相關性分群，群內比 60 日漲幅
items.en: Compare stocks that behave alike: group by daily-return correlation, rank 60-day return within each group

formulas: MASK(VALID(GRANK(CORR_GROUP(LOGR(close, LAG(1, close))), RET(60, close))), SUB(RET(60, close), RATIO(GSUM(CORR_GROUP(LOGR(close, LAG(1, close))), RET(60, close)), GSUM(CORR_GROUP(LOGR(close, LAG(1, close))), MASK(VALID(RET(60, close)), 1:RATIO)))))

items.zh: 兩層疊加：產業內 20 日漲幅名次、市值組內 20 日漲幅名次，兩個名次平均
items.en: Two layers: average of the 20-day return rank within the industry and within the market-cap group

formulas: ADD(CS_PEER_RANK(1, RET(20, close)), RATIO(GRANK(CS_QCUT(10, fund.mktcap), RET(20, close)), ADD(SUB(GCOUNT(CS_QCUT(10, fund.mktcap), RET(20, close)), 1:COUNT), SUB(GCOUNT(CS_QCUT(10, fund.mktcap), RET(20, close)), 1:COUNT))))

items.zh: 季報公布後第 5 個交易日，照公布以來的漲幅排名
items.en: On the 5th trading day after a quarterly report, rank by the return since the report

formulas: MASK(LAG(5, EV_CHANGE(revenue)), RATIO(close, LATCH(EV_CHANGE(revenue), LAG(1, close))))

items.zh: 上次月營收創 12 個月新高以來，股價最高點到今天的回落幅度，回落越少越前
items.en: Since monthly revenue last hit a 12-month high, the pullback from the highest price to today; smaller pullback ranks higher

formulas: RATIO(close, SCANMAX(EV_CHANGE(revenue_m) && revenue_m >= ROLL_MAX(250, revenue_m), close))

items.zh: 個股 20 日漲幅減掉同產業平均漲幅（個股對群的相對強度）
items.en: 20-day return minus the industry's average return (stock vs its group)

items.zh: 所屬產業的 20 日平均漲幅減掉全市場平均（群對市場），群裡每檔拿同一個分數
items.en: The industry's 20-day average return minus the market's average (group vs market); every stock of the industry gets the same score

formulas: SUB(XL_PARENT(1, RET(20, close)), RATIO(GSUM(0, RET(20, close)), GSUM(0, MASK(VALID(RET(20, close)), 1:RATIO))))

items.zh: 等權大盤在 200 日均線之上用 60 日動能，之下改用 60 日低波動
items.en: 60-day momentum while the equal-weight market is above its 200-day average, 60-day low volatility below it

formulas: idx.taiex > ROLL_MEAN(200, idx.taiex) ? CS_PCT(RET(60, close)) : CS_PCT(NEG(ROLL_STD(60, LOGR(close, LAG(1, close)))))

items.zh: 20 日漲幅平方乘上量比，再取對數
items.en: Log of the squared 20-day return times the volume ratio

formulas: LOG(MUL(MUL(RET(20, close), RET(20, close)), VOL_RATIO(20, volume)))

items.zh: 財報月（3、5、8、11 月）照盈餘成長排，其他月照 60 日動能排
items.en: In reporting months (Mar, May, Aug, Nov) rank by earnings growth, otherwise by 60-day momentum

formulas: MONTH() in {3, 5, 8, 11} ? CS_PCT(FN_EGROW(252, eps)) : CS_PCT(RET(60, close))

items.zh: 每月前 5 個交易日用短線反轉，其他日子用 20 日動能
items.en: Short-term reversal in the first 5 trading days of each month, 20-day momentum otherwise

items.zh: 離 52 週高點拉回 5%～10% 的給最高分，拉回更多或更少都扣分（分段函數）
items.en: Highest score for a 5-10% pullback from the 52-week high, lower for more or less (piecewise score)

formulas: (DIST_HIGH(250, close) <= -0.05 && DIST_HIGH(250, close) >= -0.1) ? 0:RATIO : NEG(MIN2(ABS(ADD(DIST_HIGH(250, close), 0.05:RATIO)), ABS(ADD(DIST_HIGH(250, close), 0.1:RATIO))))

items.zh: 毛利率連續 3 季上升的，照最近一季上升幅度排
items.en: Gross margin up three quarters in a row, ranked by the latest quarter's rise

formulas: MASK(RATIO(fund.gross, revenue) > RWIN(1, 0, RATIO(fund.gross, revenue)) && RWIN(1, 0, RATIO(fund.gross, revenue)) > RWIN(2, 0, RATIO(fund.gross, revenue)) && RWIN(2, 0, RATIO(fund.gross, revenue)) > RWIN(3, 0, RATIO(fund.gross, revenue)), RWIN(1, 7, RATIO(fund.gross, revenue)))

items.zh: 營收年增的產業內百分位，減掉股價年漲幅的產業內百分位（基本面跑贏股價）
items.en: Industry percentile of revenue growth minus industry percentile of the one-year price return (fundamentals ahead of price)

formulas: SUB(CS_PEER_RANK(1, RWIN_PCT(12, revenue_m)), CS_PEER_RANK(1, RET(250, close)))

items.zh: 價值、品質、動能三個因子等權排名（本益比倒數、ROE、12 個月動能）
items.en: Value, quality and momentum equally weighted (earnings yield, ROE, 12-month momentum)

formulas: ADD(ADD(CS_PCT(FN_EP(eps, close)), CS_PCT(FN_ROE(net_income, equity))), CS_PCT(RET_SKIP(252, 21, close)))

items.zh: 離上市以來最高價的距離，越近越前
items.en: Distance from the highest price since listing; closer ranks higher

items.zh: 自己組 14 日 RSI，越低越前
items.en: A self-built 14-day RSI, lower ranks higher

definitions.name: user.local.RSI
definitions.body: RATIO(SMOOTH($k, 0.071429:RATIO, MAX2(DIFF(1, x), 0:PRICE)), ADD(SMOOTH($k, 0.071429:RATIO, MAX2(DIFF(1, x), 0:PRICE)), SMOOTH($k, 0.071429:RATIO, MAX2(NEG(DIFF(1, x)), 0:PRICE))))

items.zh: 外資連續買超的天數，越多越前
items.en: Days of consecutive foreign net buying; more ranks higher

items.zh: 外資持股比率 60 日增加幅度
items.en: 60-day change in foreign ownership

items.zh: 千張大戶持股比這週增加、而且股東人數減少，照大戶持股增幅排
items.en: Holders of 1,000+ lots up this week while the number of shareholders fell, ranked by the rise of large holders

formulas: MASK(RWIN(1, 7, tdcc_big1000_pct) > 0 && RWIN(1, 7, tdcc_people) < 0, RWIN(1, 7, tdcc_big1000_pct))

items.zh: 低本益比，但只在同產業裡比（產業內本益比倒數百分位）
items.en: Low P/E, compared only within the same industry

items.zh: 股價對 5 年均線的偏離，看它一年來的變化
items.en: Price's deviation from its 5-year average, and how that deviation changed over a year

items.zh: 發布重大訊息後 3 天的漲幅排名
items.en: Rank by the 3-day return after a material announcement

items.zh: 強勢產業的股票優先，同一個產業裡市值大的先選（分數一樣時的第二排序）
items.en: Stocks of strong industries first; within one industry the larger market cap first (second sort key for ties)

formulas: SUB(XL_PARENT(1, RET(20, close)), RATIO(GSUM(0, RET(20, close)), GSUM(0, MASK(VALID(RET(20, close)), 1:RATIO))))

items.zh: 跟台積電日報酬相關性越高排越前面
items.en: Higher correlation with TSMC's daily returns ranks first

formulas: CORR(250, RET(1, close), BASKET_MEAN(symbol == "2330", RET(1, close)))

items.zh: 市值分十組，組內比 20 日漲幅（比同組平均高多少）
items.en: Split market cap into ten groups; rank by 20-day return above the group average

items.zh: 上個月漲最多的
items.en: Biggest gainers of last month

items.zh: 近 20 天外資平均買超（沒資料的日子不算）
items.en: Average foreign net buying over the last 20 days (days without data not counted)

items.zh: 每天漲跌封頂 ±10% 之後的 20 日平均漲幅
items.en: 20-day average return after capping each day's move at ±10%

items.zh: 同產業的平均 20 日漲幅（產業動能）
items.en: Industry average 20-day return (industry momentum)

items.zh: 過去 20 天上漲天數減下跌天數
items.en: Up days minus down days over the past 20 days

items.zh: 動能的回看天數讓系統試：半年（126 天）和一年（252 天），都跳過最近一個月
items.en: Let the system try momentum lookbacks of half a year (126 days) and one year (252 days), both skipping the latest month

items.zh: 今天成交量是 20 日均量 3 倍以上的才給分，照漲幅排
items.en: Score only stocks trading 3x their 20-day average volume today, ranked by return

items.zh: 資金同步湧入的一群：用成交量的相關性分群，群平均量比放大最多那群裡的股票優先
items.en: Money flowing in together: group by volume correlation, the group with the biggest average volume surge first

formulas: RATIO(GSUM(CORR_GROUP(volume), VOL_RATIO(20, volume)), GSUM(CORR_GROUP(volume), MASK(VALID(VOL_RATIO(20, volume)), 1:RATIO)))

items.zh: 法人同步買的一群：用外資買賣超的相關性分群，群近 5 日合計買超最多的優先
items.en: Institutions buying together: group by foreign net-buy correlation, the group with the most 5-day net buying first

items.zh: 連續 3 天量增價漲
items.en: Volume and price both up three days in a row

formulas: MASK(COUNT(3, volume > LAG(1, volume) && close > LAG(1, close)) >= 3, RET(3, close))

items.zh: 冷卻後再起：曾經爆量、之後至少 20 天量縮，今天再度爆量
items.en: Back after cooling down: a past volume spike, at least 20 quiet days, and a spike again today

formulas: MASK(VOL_RATIO(20, volume) >= 3 && COUNT(20, LAG(1, VOL_RATIO(20, volume) >= 3)) == 0 && COUNT(120, VOL_RATIO(20, volume) >= 3) >= 2, VOL_RATIO(20, volume))

items.zh: 當沖比（當沖量 ÷ 成交量）突然飆高的
items.en: Day-trading share (day-trade volume / volume) jumping suddenly

items.zh: 融資餘額 5 日暴增但股價沒漲（散戶追不動）
items.en: Margin balance up sharply over 5 days while the price did not rise

formulas: MASK(RET(5, margin_bal) > 0.2 && RET(5, close) <= 0, RET(5, margin_bal))

items.zh: 投信連續買超第 1 天（之前 10 天都沒買）
items.en: First day of investment-trust net buying (none in the previous 10 days)

items.zh: 當天發布 3 則以上重大訊息的股票，照量比排
items.en: Stocks with 3 or more material announcements today, ranked by volume ratio

items.zh: 每個月第一個交易日換股
items.en: Rebalance on the first trading day of each month

items.zh: 等權大盤站上 60 日均線那天才換股，其他時候不動
items.en: Rebalance only on the day the equal-weight market crosses above its 60-day average

portfolio.rebalance_when: EW_INDEX(close) > ROLL_MEAN(60, EW_INDEX(close)) && !LAG(1, EW_INDEX(close) > ROLL_MEAN(60, EW_INDEX(close)))

items.zh: 等權大盤跌破 200 日均線就降到五成持股
items.en: Cut to 50% invested when the equal-weight market falls below its 200-day average

items.zh: 依全市場 20 日波動反比調整持股（波動越大持股越少，最多滿倉）
items.en: Scale exposure by the inverse of 20-day market volatility (more volatile, less invested; at most fully invested)

portfolio.exposure: MIN2(RATIO(0.01:RATIO, ROLL_STD(20, FILL(RATIO(GSUM(0, LOGR(close, LAG(1, close))), GSUM(0, MASK(VALID(LOGR(close, LAG(1, close))), 1:RATIO))), 0:RATIO))), 1:RATIO)

items.zh: 等權大盤從一年高點回落超過 15% 時只持有三成
items.en: Hold only 30% when the equal-weight market is more than 15% below its one-year high

items.zh: 依市值開根號加權
items.en: Weight by the square root of market cap

items.zh: 收盤跌破 20 日均線的不再持有
items.en: Stop holding names that close below the 20-day average

items.zh: 每天選，每檔持有 10 個交易日到期出場
items.en: Pick every day, each name held 10 trading days

items.zh: 買進後跌 8% 停損、漲 20% 停利
items.en: Stop loss at -8%, take profit at +20% after entry

items.zh: 表現相近的同一群最多持有 3 檔
items.en: At most 3 holdings among stocks that move together

items.zh: 依分數加權，同時每檔持有 10 天
items.en: Weight by score, each daily slice held 10 days

items.zh: 金字塔加碼：已持有的股票再漲 10% 就加碼一倍
items.en: Pyramiding: add one more unit when a holding rises another 10%

items.zh: 買進後跌 5% 補一次（只補一次）
items.en: Average down once after a 5% drop from entry

items.zh: 漲 20% 先賣一半，剩下的從高點回落 10% 全出
items.en: Sell half at +20%, the rest on a 10% fall from the peak

items.zh: 最多投入八成資金、每次換股最多新買 3 檔
items.en: At most 80% invested, at most 3 new names per rebalance

items.zh: 緩衝區：排進前 10 名才買、掉出前 30 名才賣
items.en: Buffer: buy in the top 10, sell when out of the top 30

items.zh: 只在財報月（3、5、8、11 月）的第一個交易日換股
items.en: Rebalance only on the first trading day of reporting months (Mar, May, Aug, Nov)

items.zh: 每週五換股
items.en: Rebalance every Friday

items.zh: 每月定期投入 5,000 元，持有 10 檔，零股
items.en: Invest 5,000 TWD every month, 10 stocks, odd lots

items.zh: 最多 10 檔、單檔上限 15%、依波動倒數加權
items.en: At most 10 stocks, at most 15% each, inverse-volatility weights

items.zh: 追蹤停損：從買進後最高點回落 10% 就出場
items.en: Trailing stop: exit after a 10% fall from the highest close since entry

items.zh: 依 20 日均成交金額加權，但單檔最多 10%
items.en: Weight by 20-day average traded value, at most 10% per stock

items.zh: 收盤跌破買進價 8% 或收盤漲過 20% 才賣（收盤確認）
items.en: Sell only on a close 8% below entry or 20% above (close-confirmed)

items.zh: 盤中跌破 20 日均線就賣
items.en: Sell intraday once the price falls below the 20-day average

items.zh: 跌 8% 或從最高收盤回落 10%，先碰到的就賣
items.en: Sell at -8% or after a 10% fall from the highest close, whichever comes first
Try a few stop and take-profit levels: stops 5%, 8%, 10%; take profit 15%, 20%, 30%

items.zh: 從最高點回落幾 % 出場，6% 到 14% 讓系統自己找
items.en: Trailing stop level between 6% and 14%, let the system find it

items.zh: 跌破幾倍波動就停損、最多抱幾天，兩個一起試
items.en: Try the volatility multiple of the stop and the longest holding period together

items.zh: 盤中停損停利的幅度讓系統試：跌到買進價的 90%、92%、95%，漲到 115%、125%
items.en: Let the system try intraday stop and take-profit levels: 90%, 92%, 95% and 115%, 125% of the entry price

items.zh: 每天買前 10 名、每檔抱 10 天，期間跌 8% 先停損
items.en: Buy the top 10 every day, hold each 10 days, stop loss at -8% meanwhile

items.zh: 成交金額切五等分，每一等分最多買 2 檔
items.en: Traded-value quintiles, at most 2 holdings per quintile

items.zh: 同一群最多 2 檔，而且掉出前 30 名才賣
items.en: At most 2 per group, and sell only when out of the top 30

items.zh: 全市場站上 60 日均線的股票不到三成時只持有五成
items.en: Hold only 50% when fewer than 30% of the market is above its 60-day moving average

items.zh: 上漲家數多於下跌家數那天才換股
items.en: Rebalance only on days with more advancers than decliners

portfolio.rebalance_when: MKT_COUNT(close > LAG(1, close)) > MKT_COUNT(close < LAG(1, close))

items.zh: 每季第一個交易日換股
items.en: Rebalance on the first trading day of each quarter

items.zh: 每年第一個交易日換股
items.en: Rebalance on the first trading day of each year

items.zh: 站上年線之後才持有、跌破季線才賣
items.en: Hold after crossing above the 250-day line; sell only after falling below the 60-day line

portfolio.hold: STATE(close > ROLL_MEAN(250, close), close < ROLL_MEAN(60, close))

items.zh: 動能天數試 60、120 天，停損試 8%、10%，一起找
items.en: Try momentum lengths of 60 and 120 days together with stop losses of 8% and 10%

items.zh: 每週第一個交易日換股（週一放假就週二），2020 年起才開始選
items.en: Rebalance on the first trading day of each week (Tuesday when Monday is a holiday), picking only from 2020 on

items.zh: ROMAD（年化報酬 ÷ 最大回撤）至少 1 才收
items.en: Keep only strategies with RoMaD (annual return / max drawdown) of at least 1

definitions.name: user.local.ROMAD
definitions.description: 年化報酬 ÷ 最大回撤

items.zh: 月勝率至少六成
items.en: Monthly win rate of at least 60%

items.zh: 最長水下天數（從前高跌下到回到前高的最長天數）不超過 250 天
items.en: Longest time under water (from a peak back to that peak) at most 250 days

items.zh: 每一年都要贏等權大盤
items.en: Beat the equal-weight market every single year

items.zh: 多頭和空頭市況下 Sharpe 都要大於 0.5
items.en: Sharpe above 0.5 in both bull and bear markets

items.zh: 交易成本加倍後淨報酬仍然要是正的
items.en: Net return still positive with trading costs doubled

items.zh: 前後兩半期間的 IC 要同號
items.en: IC with the same sign in both halves of the period

definitions.name: user.local.HALVES
definitions.description: 前後兩半 IC 同號

items.zh: 最差的一年報酬不能低於 −20%
items.en: Worst year no lower than -20%

items.zh: 同類股替換後報酬至少保留五成
items.en: Keep at least half the return after the peer-swap check

items.zh: 分 4 段，至少 3 段 IC 為正
items.en: Four segments, IC positive in at least three

items.zh: 近三年回測（2023 起）年化至少 10%
items.en: Last three years (from 2023) at least 10% a year

items.zh: 七成以上的年份要贏大盤指數（加權報酬指數）
items.en: Beat the market index (the weighted total-return index) in at least 70% of the years

items.zh: 對大盤指數的年化超額報酬至少 5%
items.en: Annualized excess return over the market index of at least 5%

items.zh: 任何一年的持有期都不能虧超過 15%
items.en: No one-year holding period may lose more than 15%

items.zh: Sharpe 大於 1，而且同類股替換後報酬保留 26% 以上（一條門檻）
items.en: Sharpe above 1 and at least 26% of the return kept after same-group stock swaps (one threshold)

items.zh: 滾動半年的平均日報酬最差也要大於 0
items.en: Even the worst rolling half-year average daily return must be above 0

items.zh: 幾組投組設定裡照 Calmar 挑
items.en: Pick among several portfolio settings by Calmar

items.zh: 只買股號尾數跟今天日期尾數相同的股票
items.en: Only stocks whose code ends with the same digit as today's date

items.zh: 上個月漲最多的那個產業裡，這個月量縮最多的股票
items.en: In last month's best industry, the stocks whose volume shrank most this month

formulas: MASK(XL_PARENT(1, RATIO(AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, close)), AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, close)))))) >= GMAX(0, XL_PARENT(1, RATIO(AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, close)), AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, close))))))), NEG(RATIO(RATIO(SCANSUM(TDAY_OF_MONTH() == 1, volume), AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, SCANSUM(TDAY_OF_MONTH() == 1, volume)))), RATIO(TDAY_OF_MONTH(), AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, TDAY_OF_MONTH()))))))

items.zh: 跟三檔種子股的營收年增相關性高、但股價相關性低的股票
items.en: High correlation of revenue growth with three seed stocks but low price correlation

items.zh: 每月 13 號剛好是星期五就全部出清（那天曝險 0）
items.en: Go to cash whenever the 13th of a month is a Friday (exposure 0 that day)

items.zh: 收盤價個位數是 8 的股票
items.en: Stocks whose close ends in the digit 8

items.zh: 月營收公布當天的漲幅排名（看公告當天的反應）
items.en: Rank by the return on the day monthly revenue is published

items.zh: 外資連賣 10 天之後第一天轉買
items.en: First day of foreign net buying after 10 days of net selling

formulas: MASK(foreign_net > 0 && COUNT(10, LAG(1, foreign_net < 0)) >= 10, RATIO(foreign_net, volume))

items.zh: 星期一跌最多的股票，星期二買
items.en: Buy on Tuesday the stocks that fell most on Monday

items.zh: 每個產業裡股價最低的那一檔
items.en: The lowest-priced stock in each industry

items.zh: 市值排名天天大幅變動的（市值百分位 60 日標準差最大）
items.en: Stocks whose market-cap rank swings the most (60-day std of the market-cap percentile)

items.zh: 價格跟成交量的 60 日相關性最負的
items.en: Most negative 60-day correlation between price and volume

items.zh: 過去 5 年每年 12 月都上漲的股票
items.en: Stocks that rose every December for the past five years

formulas: MASK(COUNT(1260, MONTH() == 1 && TDAY_OF_MONTH() == 1 && AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, close)) > AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, AT_MONTH_START(LAG(1, close))))) >= 5, RET(20, close))

items.zh: 股價在同產業裡排名跟市值在同產業裡排名差最多的（價格偏離規模）
items.en: Largest gap between price rank and market-cap rank within the industry

items.zh: 用「月營收年增」的相關性分群，群內比股價 20 日漲幅，只看跟群平均漲幅落差最大的
items.en: Group by monthly-revenue-growth correlation, compare 20-day returns within each group, the largest gap from the group average first

formulas: ABS(SUB(RET(20, close), RATIO(GSUM(CORR_GROUP(1260, 126, 21, 3000, 1, RWIN_PCT(12, revenue_m)), RET(20, close)), GSUM(CORR_GROUP(1260, 126, 21, 3000, 1, RWIN_PCT(12, revenue_m)), MASK(VALID(RET(20, close)), 1:RATIO)))))

items.zh: 最近 4 次季報公布當天，平均反應（當天漲幅）最大的股票
items.en: Largest average reaction (same-day return) on the last 4 quarterly-report days

items.zh: 60 日動能的名次加 5% 雜訊後還選得出來的股票（同一份種子重跑結果不變）
items.en: Stocks that still get picked when 5% noise is added to the 60-day momentum rank (the same seed reruns identically)

items.zh: 每個產業只看市值前 3 大，裡面 20 日漲最多的
items.en: Within each industry, only the 3 largest by market cap; among them, the biggest 20-day gainers

items.zh: 這三個想法一起回測，各自出結果
items.en: Backtest these three ideas together, one result each

items.zh: 讓系統自己隨機生成 200 個公式來找
items.en: Let the system generate 200 random formulas and search

items.zh: 隨機生成時也抽大盤層的欄與表現相近的股票群
items.en: Random generation that also samples market-level columns and groups of similar stocks

items.zh: 離 N 日高點的距離，N 試 60、120、250 三種
items.en: Distance from the N-day high, trying N = 60, 120 and 250

items.zh: 同類股替換後淨報酬至少保留六成才收
items.en: Keep a strategy only if the peer swap keeps at least 60% of the net return

items.zh: 最近一年（最後 252 個交易日）IC 也要為正
items.en: IC must also be positive over the last year (last 252 trading days)

definitions.name: user.local.LAST_YEAR
definitions.description: 最後 252 個交易日 IC 為正

items.zh: 每週換股和每月換股都要賺錢
items.en: Must make money with both weekly and monthly rebalancing

definitions.name: user.local.BOTH_FREQ
definitions.description: 每 5 日與每 21 日換股的淨報酬都 > 0

items.zh: 只在隨機一半的股票裡選、成本又變三倍，還要賺錢
items.en: Still profitable on a random half of the stocks with costs tripled

definitions.name: user.local.HALF_X3
definitions.description: 隨機一半股票、單邊成本 ×3 的淨報酬 > 0

items.zh: 只持有 10 檔時也要賺錢，而且最大跌幅不超過 40%
items.en: Profitable with only 10 holdings, max drawdown at most 40%

definitions.name: user.local.TEN
definitions.description: 只持有 10 檔的淨報酬 > 0、最大回撤 ≤ $max_dd_bp

items.zh: 前後兩半各自用樣本內挑做多門檻、樣本外驗證，兩段都要賺
items.en: Pick the long threshold in-sample and confirm out-of-sample; both windows must make money

definitions.name: user.local.WF2
definitions.description: 滾動兩段：IS 挑 p_long、OOS 淨報酬都 > 0
